name: job-hunter
description: End-to-end job-hunt cold outreach automation. Framework-agnostic: the outreach-mcp server runs identically under Claude Code, Codex, and Codex terminal. Configure via env vars: HUNTER_API_KEY (required), GMAIL_ADDRESS + GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD (default SMTP send — works on every OS), APOLLO_API_KEY/CONTACTOUT_API_KEY/LEMLIST_API_KEY (optional paid). LinkedIn actions run in the user's own logged-in Chrome (Claude in Chrome) per references/linkedin-playbook.md, with the bundled macos-automator server (drives real Chrome via AppleScript) as the mac fallback. The 'local' channel sends through the desktop mail client (Mail.app/Outlook send; Linux & non-Outlook Windows compose pre-filled); SMTP is the cross-platform default.
